reported_mass_qualifier: each load described as a little under the approximate value
interim_storage_duration_basis: contractor-reported maximum; exact elapsed time not verified
freshness_observation: loads varied in freshness; some material was already hot and smelled of fermenting grass
sand_observation: high sand fraction attributed by report to very short mowing
litter_observation: nearly no visible litter; no prior litter-removal pass
applicability: Phase 1 collection/contamination context and Phase 2 interim-handling context; not an annual supply estimate
limitations: Campaign summary only; individual truck masses, moisture, area, route length, accessible verge area, sample-by-load composition, and delivered dry matter are not reported here. The approximate load quantity is not annualized or summed.
